title: IROKA GENESIS Shared Evidence Contract

governance.owner_approval: 2026-11-16: approval of bounded A3 implementation scope
governance.architecture_constraint: Preserve 12 chromosomes and 36 genes; do not add g05.data-rights.
governance.compatibility: Gene schemas embed these definitions locally under $defs. No external $ref is introduced.
scope: Reuse the same definitions in all 72 gene schemas
Validate all positive and negative conformance vectors against the exact resulting commit

provenance.description: A closed, attributable record of where evidence originated, who or what supplied it, how it was acquired, and its observed trust state. Provenance records do not confer authority or permission.

version_bound_evidence.description: Binds an evidence-bearing record to the exact gene, schema, contract, artifact digest, evaluator and evaluation time. A binding is descriptive evidence, not authorization.

evidence.description: A closed pairing of provenance and version-bound evidence.

normative_invariants: Every provenance source_id, actor_id and source_digest is non-empty.
Every provenance observed_at is an RFC 3339 date-time accepted by the Draft 2020-12 date-time format checker.
A provenance trust_state of revoked or disputed must not be represented as verified.
Every version-bound record identifies the exact gene, gene version, schema ID/version, contract ID/version, artifact digest, evaluator and evaluation time.
A schema or contract version mismatch is a verification failure, not a warning.
An evidence object must contain both provenance and version_bound_evidence.
Unknown properties are rejected at every shared evidence object boundary.
Evidence is descriptive and cannot grant authority, capability, consent, execution permission or policy override.
No external schema reference is introduced; local definitions are embedded in each gene schema.
The existing 12 chromosomes and 36 genes remain unchanged.

positive: Complete provenance and version-bound records with valid date-times are accepted.
Evidence containing both closed records is accepted.
negative: Missing any required provenance or version-bound field is rejected.
Unknown fields in provenance, version-bound evidence or evidence are rejected.
Wrong field types, invalid enum values and malformed date-times are rejected.
A mismatched gene/schema/contract version is rejected by semantic conformance checks.
An evidence object missing either nested record is rejected.
Evidence must never be interpreted as an authorization grant.
